title: Geologic Map of the Congaree 7.5-minute quadrangle
citation: Shelley, D.C., 2005, Geologic Map of the Congaree 7.5-minute quadrangle: South Carolina Geological Survey Geologic Quadrangle Map GQM-31, map scale 1:24,000.
notes: OCR of a map sheet with badly interleaved columns; much of the unit text is garbled and only legible parts are recorded. Cross section A-A' (vertical exaggeration 20) read from page image tiles: 13 projected (dashed) drill holes with unit intervals as elevations read off the feet scale (+/-2 ft, inferred); no land-surface elevations recorded because the holes are projected. Hole 40-45 (drawn above the profile) is left out. No horizontal scale, so no distances or contact points. Many references skipped (general or garbled).
